architecture.mechanism: Built-in fuel source triggering chemical decomposition to generate gas pressure for active, controllable payload delivery without external power.
architecture.intervention: Integrate a micro-reactor chamber containing platinum nanoparticles and hydrogen peroxide into the fuel rail to generate auxiliary gas pressure during acceleration spikes, bypassing the intermittent electrical failure of the primary fuel pump.
architecture.expected_effect: Restoration of consistent fuel flow during high-demand acceleration events, eliminating engine stalling without reliance on the failing electrical drive system.
architecture.falsification_test: Operate the modified fuel delivery system under simulated load while disconnecting the primary electric fuel pump; if engine stall occurs despite reactor activation, the mechanism is insufficient.
